The DPGA blog says DHIS2 data completeness rose from 88% to 95% and timeliness from 60% to 90%+.

The Ministry of Health says its national Health Intelligence Center takes in DHIS2, described as the Health Management Information System, among its sources, with data from village health workers to national referral hospitals.

The Ministry of Health says the Health Intelligence Center integrates DHIS2 with eLMIS (logistics), CRVS, eBuzima and cEMR medical records, and uses the data for disease surveillance and outbreak early warning.

The Global Fund case study says Rwanda has a national health management information system (HMIS) to which community and laboratory data are linked, and that its investments in HMIS are delivering measurable results.

The Global Fund case study says Rwanda's electronic community health information system (eCHIS) is linked to the national HMIS for surveillance of malaria, TB and HIV, and that laboratory information systems are interoperable with the HMIS and the Reagent Management System.
